name: LanceFinder.java
summary: DeviceFinder implementation that locates AMD Lance/PCnet NICs on the PCI bus. It looks up core system services (Ports, IRQ, MemoryManager, CPUManager) via Naming, polls for the PCIAccess access point, and scans PCI network-class devices for the AMD vendor ID 0x1022 with device ID 0x2000 (Am79C970).

name: LanceDriver.java
summary: NetworkDevice implementation driving the AMD Lance/PCnet NIC. Wraps a LanceCore, creates CPU events for interrupt/send/receive, manages a MultiThreadBufferList of usable buffers, and exposes transmit, transmit1, getMACAddress, getMTU, consumer registration, and open/close lifecycle methods.

name: LanceFlags.java
summary: Configuration flags container for the Lance/PCnet driver. Holds the device name, chip name, full-duplex, auto-select and must-unreset settings, with setForVersion mapping chip version codes to human-readable PCnet chip names.

name: build-impl.xml
summary: NetBeans-generated Ant build implementation containing macrodefs and targets for initialization, compilation (with module/processor support), JAR creation, execution, debugging, Javadoc generation, test compilation/execution (JUnit 4 and TestNG), profiling, and cleanup. Defines the complete build lifecycle for the testNET project.

name: genfiles.properties
summary: Tracks CRC32 checksums of generated files (build.xml, build-impl.xml data/script/stylesheet) to detect when NetBeans should regenerate build-impl.xml from project.xml.
